name: Butternut Squash, Sausage, Spinach and Mushroom Pasta Bake
subtitle: A creamy baked pasta with roasted squash and savory sausage
description: Roasted butternut squash, sausage, mushrooms, and greens are folded through fusilli with a mustard-Parmesan sauce, then baked until bubbling and set.

ingredients.preparation: peeled, deseeded and cut into 2-3cm cubes

ingredients.item: olive oil plus extra for the dish
whole milk plus extra for topping up
grated parmesan plus extra to serve

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Oil a baking dish. Toss the squash with the olive oil, arrange it in a roasting pan with the sausages and sage, and roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until the squash is tender and the sausage reaches 160°F internally.

Meanwhile, melt the butter in a saucepan. Stir in the flour and cook briefly, then gradually whisk in the milk. Simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring, until smooth and thick; add a little extra milk if needed.
Stir the nutmeg, Parmesan, and mustard into the sauce until the cheese melts. Cook the fusilli according to its package directions, then drain.
Heat a little olive oil in a large pan. Cook the mushrooms and garlic until softened, then add the chopped kale, chard, or spinach and cook until wilted.
Cut the roasted sausages into bite-size pieces. Combine the pasta, vegetables, squash, sausage, sage, and sauce, then transfer to the prepared dish. Top with the remaining Parmesan.
Bake for 30 minutes, until bubbling and set in the center. Rest briefly before serving.
